text.tspan: Covers US 1.0.1, 1.0.3 and 1.0.4. No profile page exists in the code. All Profile page steps are Proposed.

g.text: [Open profile from a Site page (1.0.1 AT3)]

text.tspan: [No valid session or account not approved]
Data is read again on each load, with no cache (1.0.1 AT5).
A new SIR adds 1 to the count on next load (1.0.4 AT2).
Open questions: where profile fields are stored, which answers count as "activities",
how a steward marks answers as hidden, and whether legacy (inspectheader) SIRs count.

Open profile of the SIR user_id (Proposed)
Check session and approved account on server (Proposed)
Read name, contact info, skills, focus areas
Calculate SIR count and activity totals (1.0.4)
Show profile, quick stats and SIR history
Select a SIR in the history
Remove answers the steward chose to hide (Proposed)
